title: Show a room mood line on capabilities
summary: Studio should read a short mood line for the active room from GET /api/capabilities. The line is user-facing and must stay dark until the LaunchDarkly flag decor-room-mood is turned on. The code default is off.
acceptance: GET /api/capabilities omits room_mood when decor-room-mood is off
GET /api/capabilities includes room_mood calm linen when the flag is on
The flag key decor-room-mood defaults off in code
